newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore, Thailand join U.S. in air exercise.
newsitem.headline: Singapore, Thailand join U.S. in air exercise.

text.p: An annual joint exercise involving the air forces of Singapore, Thailand and the United States has begun, Singapore's Defence Ministry said in a statement on Monday.
The exercise, called Ex Cope Tiger, will be conducted in two phases, the statement said.

The first phase, which began on Monday at Singapore's Paya Lebar airbase, will enable officers from all three countries to get to know each others' operating procedures through planning exercises and mission commanders' training, the statement said.

The second phase, the flying training exercise, will be held in Thailand on January 16 to 29 next year. It will involve aircraft from the U.S. 13th Air Force, including F-15 fighters, and F-18 warplanes from the U.S. Marine corps, as well as planes from Thailand and Singapore.
